title: coldenia hispidissima
intro: Coldenia hispidissima, commonly known as hispid ball mustard or hairy ball mustard, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Philippines, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in treating various health conditions such as skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Coldenia hispidissima include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
